paragraphs: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the FreeAgent accounting API. Enables LLMs to manage contacts, invoices, estimates, bills, expenses, timeslips, projects, tasks, bank accounts, and more.
By my own admission, most of this project is vibe coded.
features: Broad FreeAgent coverage: contacts, invoices (incl. transitions, email, duplicate, direct debit), estimates, bills, recurring invoices, price list items, expenses, timeslips, projects, tasks, bank…

Intent-bundle tools: reconcilebanktransaction, logexpense, and invoicefromtimeslips collapse multi-call sequences into single tool calls and resolve human-friendly hints (names, codes, references) to FreeAgent URLs…

Tool-search mode (FREEAGENTTOOLSEARCH=true): optional — collapses the catalog behind freeagentsearchtools / freeagentcalltool for a smaller tools/list. Default is the full catalog (including on Vercel)
MCP elicitation: createinvoice falls back to a form elicitation when contact is omitted (on clients that support it)
Two deployment modes: local (stdio) or cloud (Vercel serverless via Streamable HTTP)
